groups.sentence: Instructors may consider integrity pledges or statements that AI was not used as an additional option.
Units and universities consider developing, adopting or altering an honor code or pledge.
Students sign an academic integrity agreement or AI contract and agree to abide by its terms at the start of the course.
Instructors have students sign an honor code, integrity pledge or statement of understanding at the start of the course.
Instructors discuss academic integrity with students at the start of the class.
Instructors or supervisors obtain acknowledgement from students that they understand the expectations set for them.
Students have already signed the Honor Code pledge.
Students attest with each submission that the work is their own and that they attribute any tools and sources used.
Students include a statement with their work, such as an integrity statement, a note on permitted GenAI use, or responsibility for accuracy.
Instructors include a declaration of honesty or an affirmation that submitted work is the student's own in assignments.
Instructors have students sign or reaffirm an honor pledge or honor statement on each assignment, test or exam.
